warnings: Grid bubbles 1-8 (x) and A-E (y) are printed on S-01..S-05. Bays: x 5.50 x 7 = 38.50 (S-01 and S-02 agree); y A-B 4.00, B-C 5.00, C-D 5.00, D-E 5.00 = 19.00 (S-01 and S-02 agree). Origin A1 (top-left).

Dummies come from S-02's dimension rows (rule 4): mid-bay ticks at 2.75 in every bay (secondary beams B7), 1.50 left of grid 2 (B8, left canopy bay), 1.375 + 1.375 in the 7'-8 half bay (B8, right), edges 1.50 outside grids 1, 8 and E; y: 3.00 below A (B11), 1.50 below A (B12, right chain). S-03 adds the lower-roof canopy tips 2.00 outside grids 1 and 8 and below row E (1' -2.00, 8''' 40.50, E''' 21.00); 1' (-2.00), 1'' (-1.50) and 1''' (-1.00, S-05) share grid 1's prime sequence with the in-bay dummies 1'''' (2.75) and 1''''' (4.00).

Conflict: the top edge above row A is printed 1.75 on the left chain and 1.85 on the right chain, both apparently to the same drawn canopy edge. They differ by 0.10 m, so both are kept as lines (A'' -1.85, A''' -1.75) per rule 4 rather than picking one. The canopy edge beams B4/B10 and the canopy cantilevers were placed on A''' (-1.75, the chain printed on the side where B10/B9 are drawn); the 1.85 reading is plausible (it may run to the outer slab edge), so A'' carries a lowered score.

Dimension sweep in this run covered only the structural plans S-01 (page 16), S-02 (page 17), S-03 (page 18) S-04 (page 19) and S-05 (page 20). The architectural sheets (A-02..A-13, pages 4-15) and S-06..S-13 (pages 21-28) were NOT swept: the op04 run was cut short by the scheduled shutdown, and their dimension rows still have to be added.
Element-internal dimensions (footing sizes, beam/slab section sizes) are kept on the elements, not here.

S-04 (page 19) adds y A' -2.00 and E' 20.00 (truss tips: printed 2.00 above A and 1.00 below E) and D' 17.00 for truss T2, which no chain dimensions — measured by proportion between D and E (scaled_from_grid, lowered score). Existing dummies were re-sequenced in reading order with every ref in this house renamed (A' -2.00, A'' -1.85, A''' -1.75, A'''' 1.50, A''''' 3.00; E' 20.00, E'' 20.50, E''' 21.00).

S-05 (page 20) adds x lines at the purlin ends printed 1.00 outside grids 1 and 8: grid-1 and grid-8 dummies re-sequenced in reading order with every ref renamed (1' -2.00, 1'' -1.50, 1''' -1.00, 1'''' 2.75, 1''''' 4.00; 8' 39.50, 8'' 40.00, 8''' 40.50).
S-08 (page 23) reprints the 1-8 5.50 chain under each beam elevation (3 rows, recorded); its bar cut-off rows are element-internal and are not grid lines.

S-09 (page 24) beam elevations reprint x 4.00 + 1.50 (grid 1 to the B8 line to grid 2), the 5.50 bays, and y bays with the canopy cantilever 1.75 beyond row A (B5/1, B6/1) — recorded; this is 3 prints of 1.75 against the single 1.85 on S-02's right chain. Bar cut-off rows are element-internal.

op04 dimension sweep 2026-10-23, batch 1 (A-02 page 04, A-03 page 05, A-04 page 06): every row agrees with the structural grid (x 5.50 x 7 = 38.50; y 4.00/5.00/5.00/5.00 = 19.00) and with the dummies S-02..S-05 already put on the edges (1.50 / 2.00 / 1.00 past grids 1, 8, A, E). A-02 adds two ticks in bay 7-8 (2.85 from grid 7 = 35.85, 1.30 before grid 8 = 37.20, toilet/shop end walls): new dummy lines, so the old 7'' (37.125, B8) moves to 7''' with every ref renamed by gridfix.

Decision (att1235): element-scale dimensions on the architectural plans and detail sheets (shop counter 0.80/0.40, stair tread 0.40, door/window/wall/counter heights, fixture spacings, roof-sheet and insulation specs) go to unassigned_dimensions, not to dimension_chains or new lines -- they hang off no printed grid line (spec section 4 rule 4 'not an axis tick: a dimension inside one element's own detail'), same practice as house 171. Risk: a later reader wanting e.g. the counter face as a line must derive it.

gridfix (op04 sweep 2026-10-23): dummy primes re-sequenced into reading order (spec section 4 Dummy grid) -- 7'' -> 7'''; grid refs in every file of the house follow; prose in older warnings still uses the old names

op04 dimension sweep batch 2 (A-05 page 07, A-06 page 08 elevations): x rows 1.50 | 5.50 x 7 | 1.50 and the roof edge 1.00 past grid 8 agree with the master; the y rows print 1.70 beyond A (base/walkway edge) -- a new dummy at -1.70, 0.05 m from A''' (-1.75, the S-02/S-09/A-02/A-07 canopy-edge line). Spec section 4 rule 4 says keep both and say so: kept both, y dummies past A''' re-sequenced (old A'''' 1.50 -> A''''', old A''''' 3.00 -> A'''''') with every ref renamed by gridfix.

Elevation z rows: 0.50 (±0.00 -> floor +0.50) and 3.00 (-> +3.50 ระดับใต้ท้องคาน) on all four elevations; 6.30 overall on รูปด้าน 1, 2 and 4 -- an unlabelled top (+6.30, dummy level), different from the section's +6.10 top of column and +6.50 ridge.

gridfix (op04 sweep 2026-10-23): dummy primes re-sequenced into reading order (spec section 4 Dummy grid) -- A'''' -> A''''', A''''' -> A''''''; grid refs in every file of the house follow; prose in older warnings still uses the old names

op04 dimension sweep batch 3 (A-07 page 09 sections A-A, B-B): y rows E'' 1.50 / E''' 2.00 / A''' 1.75 / A' 2.00 and x rows 1.50 | 2.75 x 14 | 1.50, 2.00 | 5.50 x 7 | 2.00, 1.00 all land on existing lines -- no new line. Levels: A-07 '▽ +0.00 ระดับพื้นดิน' is the same level as the S-01 datum 'ระดับ +0.00 ของอาคาร' (one level, one entry): the chains use the existing datum id. ระดับดินเดิม is printed with 'Varie' and no value -> level_m null (house 100 precedent).

CONFLICT (decided, att1235): A-06 รูปด้าน 4 (page 08) prints the A-E bays as 3.00 / 4.00 / 5.00 / 4.00 (= 16.00) under the bubbles A B C D E, and its panels are drawn to those widths. Every other sheet -- S-01, S-02, S-03, S-04, S-05, S-09 and A-02, A-03, A-04, A-05 รูปด้าน 2, A-07 รูปตัด A-A (11 sheets) -- prints 4.00 / 5.00 / 5.00 / 5.00 = 19.00. Kept the structural grid (op01 precedence: structural plans win, and 11 sheets against 1); A-06's row is transcribed as printed and flagged, no line moved. Most likely a drafting error carried over from a smaller standard canteen set. Its 1.70 / 1.50 overhang ticks agree with A-05.
A-07 รูปตัด B-B prints ~2.88 between +3.50 and the '+6.35 ระดับหลังแป' line, whose labels differ by 2.85: the ~ value is kept as printed (approximate), not used to move a level.

op04 dimension sweep batch 5 (A-08 page 10 .. A-13 page 15): the four grid plans A-09, A-11, A-12, A-13 each reprint x 1.50 | 5.50 x 7 | 1.50 (38.50) and y 1.75 | 4.00 | 5.00 x 3 | 1.50 (19.00) -- all on existing lines, no new line. A-08 (shop/toilet/door-window details 1:50), A-10 (furniture and wall details) and the A-13 manhole/grease-trap details print no grid bubbles: their numbers are element-internal and went to unassigned_dimensions (one entry per view). A-10 wall detail 3 prints ~2.60 between the named +3.50 and +6.10 levels -> one z chain. A-11 prints no dimension besides the plan rows (its legend gives lamp wattages and breaker ratings only). A-12 adds only pipe sizes.

A-13 prints 'ความยาวโดยประมาณ 50.00' on the x row after the 1.50 tick past grid 8 (drain run to the main drain). Decision (att1235): no line at 90.00 m -- the value is printed as approximate and the run is not drawn to scale; kept in unassigned_dimensions. Risk: rule 4 read literally would make that tick a line.
A-08 toilet room tag prints +0.45 while the same room prints +0.40 twice on A-08 and +0.40 on A-02: kept as a separate low-confidence z level (+0.45, score 0.5) rather than dropping or correcting it.

Sweep status after 2026-10-23: the architectural sheets A-02..A-13 (pages 4-15) are now swept -- this supersedes the older warning that says they were not. Not covered by batches 1-5: the cover, render and A-01 symbols/index (pages 1-3, no building dimension rows) and S-06, S-07, S-10..S-13 (pages 21, 22, 25-28) -- see the later warnings for those.

op04 dimension sweep batch 6 (S-10 page 25, S-11 page 26 truss elevations): only T2 and T3 print grid bubbles (2-3-4); their 5.50 | 5.50 rows are recorded as x chains on existing lines. The panel-point rows (~1.00 on T1, ~1.10 on T2/T3, ~1.13 / ~1.17 / ~1.10 / ~0.90 on T4, T4/1) are truss-internal and printed approximate (~). Decision (att1235): unassigned_dimensions, no new lines (spec section 4 rule 4, 'not an axis tick: a dimension inside one element's own detail'). Risk: whoever wants panel/purlin points as lines must derive them. T1's 19.00 between supports and its 1.00 / 2.00 overhangs coincide with A-E, E' and A', but no bubble is printed, so they stay with the panel row.

S-06 (page 21 footing details), S-07 (page 22 slab/column details and column table), S-12 (page 27 connection/eave details) and S-13 (page 28 canopy tie details) print no grid bubbles and only element-internal sizes, which sit on the section elements of those pages: skipped as member-detail sheets. With batches 1-6 every sheet of the set is dimension-swept except pages 1-3 (cover, render, A-01 symbols/index), which print no building dimension rows.
